source.name: CA Osasuna: 'Kosner renueva como patrocinador principal de Osasuna hasta 2028'
source.quote: Kosner renueva su compromiso con Osasuna y seguirá ocupando la parte frontal de la camiseta del primer equipo rojillo durante las temporadas 2026-27 y 2027-28

note: Renewal announced 11 Nov 2025 covers 2026-27 and 2027-28; Kosner has been main sponsor since 2023. Value not disclosed. The announcement was made during a club visit to Saltoki, exclusive distributor of Kosner products for Spain and Andorra.
